body:
DESIGN CHECKPOINT — bd-01M15ABW5GKR97CEWDQT8YCZM3. Read original 3717e7c/landed 31231d8, current sidecar.scala + SidecarSuite, codec milestone, ADR 0002 D7/D13, and current storyatlas4s consumer. NO FORMAT CODE OR PATH RESERVATION YET.

PROPOSED GRANULARITY
1. Preserve SM4SFT01 byte-for-byte and its current full-fetch API.
2. Add SM4SFT02 as ONE blocked monolith, not one file per Atlas tile. Blocks contain a positive, explicit rowsPerBlock of COMPLETE compact observed rows; last block may be shorter; rows are never split. FeatureRef.row stays the global compact row and Missing still consumes no row.
3. Do not couple storage identity to semantic tiles (projection, level, tokenRange): one target range can be sparse after missingness, and the same sidecar serves Codex/Atlas projections. The resolver takes required global rows/refs, maps them to block ordinals, and may coalesce adjacent HTTP byte ranges outside the portable codec.
4. No guessed library default. rowsPerBlock is an explicit writer input and part of file/manifest identity. A downstream exporter may later derive it from a measured byte budget; at minimum one whole row per block.

PROPOSED V2 LAYOUT
- 48-byte aligned header: ASCII SM4SFT02 plus five nonnegative uint64-LE fields in the implementation's checked signed-Long subset: payloadBytes, dimension, rowCount, dtype code, rowsPerBlock.
- blockCount is derived by overflow-safe ceil(rowCount / rowsPerBlock).
- digest index immediately follows: exactly blockCount raw 32-byte digests.
- row-major block payloads follow at offset 48 + 32*blockCount, therefore Float32/Float64 aligned. Offsets/lengths are derived, never accepted as attacker-controlled table entries.
- Evolve the typed Layout family with BlockedRowMajor(rowsPerBlock, indexChecksum); keep RowMajor's existing JSON string wire. SidecarManifest.checksum RETAINS its existing meaning: SHA-256 of the complete file. indexChecksum is SHA-256 of the exact header+digest-index prelude, allowing that small range to become the trusted root without a full fetch.
- Each index entry is domain-separated SHA-256 over block ordinal, firstRow, rowCount, and exact block payload bytes. This binds both bytes and placement; wrong-block substitution is a named failure, even for same-sized blocks.

VALIDATION CONTRACT
- Full validation checks manifest/full-file checksum, prelude root, every block digest, exact length/shape, and finite values.
- Range validation first verifies the fetched prelude against Layout.indexChecksum, then verifies every requested complete block before decoding it. It returns a private-constructor CheckedSidecarBlock/global-row result, NOT a SidecarLayout or FeatureTrack that falsely implies the unfetched file was validated. Full materialization still requires all rows/blocks.
- All arithmetic stays Long until checked Array indexes; block count, index bytes, payload offset, per-block offset, and last-block length get explicit boundary tests.
- Integrity only. Plain per-block SHA is not confidentiality, authenticity, or safe identity for non-public material. This bead will not claim sensitive-sidecar support or add an embed-core dependency; a typed keyed-sidecar receipt remains a separate boundary.

LOAD-BEARING TEST BAR, JVM/JS/Native
- exact independent golden V2 bytes/header/index plus unchanged V1 golden;
- generated finite rows, both dtypes, random positive rowsPerBlock and row subsets: verified partial rows equal the original values under declared quantization, not merely the full decoder;
- explicit Missing/compact-ref case;
- corrupt prelude/header/index, corrupt payload, wrong-block substitution, missing/duplicate/out-of-order block, truncation/trailing bytes, wrong dtype/dimension/rowCount/blockRows, non-finite payload, zero/negative blockRows;
- analytic last-safe/first-overflow cases for ceil/count/index/offset math;
- mutation proofs: remove block-digest check -> wrong-block test fails; remove prelude-root check -> index-tamper test fails.

Requested chief disposition before implementation: (A) blocked monolith vs per-tile files; (B) explicit row granularity/no default; (C) two-level integrity root (prelude + placed block digests) while preserving full-file checksum; (D) typed Layout evolution and scoped public-integrity-only statement.
